title: One-step point scalar square and point normalization
statement: Fix the finite-field datum, l≠p, finite coefficient fields E,M,L, maps E→M→L and integral comparison system C satisfying its realization coherence. The actual Frobenius point transport at iteration length one satisfies RationalPointScalarEquation 1; the inverse actual point-sections scalar comparisons satisfy PointScalarNormalization, with the identity scalar extension and successive-extension associator of [def-trf-iterated-return-transport-data].

proof.text:
Put $V=-\otimes_E M$, $B=B_E$, $B'=B_M$, $T=T_s$ and let $\alpha_N:TU_EN\xrightarrow{\sim}U_MTN$ be the one-step specified scalar comparison. Apply [lem-weil-point-automorphism-transport-scalar-extension] to $g_s$: it is a scheme automorphism and $\ell\ne p$ is invertible on $s$. Its $t^F=\Gamma(\kappa^F)\sigma^{g_s,F}$ is exactly $\iota^F$ of [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport]. With the inverse sections comparison $\varphi=\beta^{-1}$, its rational equation rearranges to
$$B'(\alpha_N)\beta_{U_EN}V(\iota_N^E)=\iota_{TN}^M\beta_N.$$
The comparison in that lemma is the canonical tensor/completion comparison, specified by [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization] as the pullback scalar family. The sections comparison is the actual map of [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension]. Thus $\alpha$ here is the one used to build $\delta$ in Step 3, rather than an arbitrary isomorphism between the same functors. For the point normalization, use the identity and tower clauses of the actual point-sections scalar theorem and invert their equations; functors preserve inverses and cancellation gives exactly the stipulated beta equations.
